items: Drugs move in the same direction every year.
The routes in between keep moving.
The countries along the way pay for it.

blocks.text: Ecuador shows the pattern: homicides rose 7× (6.5 → 45.7 per 100,000, 2015–2023) as it became a cocaine route. Associations, not causal effects; routes are the 234 documented UNODC corridors.
